sourcePressure: This chapter belongs to Action, so it must move from clear seeing into visible execution under constraint. chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The weak version turns the chapter into motivational busyness instead of a precise way to act against resistance. For "What's Right Is What Works", avoid replacing the chapter move with the whole book thesis.
